    def test_login_and_sign_out():
        # Configure Chrome options
        options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
        options.add_argument("--start-maximized")
        options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
        options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
        driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)
    
        try:
            # Step 1: Open Login Page
            with allure.step("1. Open Login Page"):
                driver.get("https://alv-vicas.livnsense.com/#/auth/login")
                WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Username']"))
                )
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="1_login_page",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            # Step 2: Login
            with allure.step("2. Login with Credentials"):
                driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Username']").send_keys("madan")
                driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Password']").send_keys("Madan@123")
                driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//button[contains(text(), 'Sign In')]").click()
    
            # Step 3: Verify Dashboard - NEW IMPROVED VERIFICATION
            with allure.step("3. Verify Dashboard Loaded"):
                # Wait for either the logo OR the username to appear
                WebDriverWait(driver, 30).until(
                    lambda d: d.find_element(By.XPATH, "//img[@alt='Autoliv']").is_displayed() or
                              d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.profile-img div.user-name").is_displayed()
                )
    
                # Alternative verification - check URL changed from login page
                WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                    lambda d: "auth/login" not in d.current_url
                )
    
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="2_dashboard_loaded",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            # Step 4: Select AIB Project
            with allure.step("4. Select AIB Project"):
                dropdown = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.region-container select.dropdown"))
                )
                select = Select(dropdown)
                select.select_by_visible_text("AIB")
                time.sleep(2)  # Wait for project to load
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="3_project_selected",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            # Step 5: Open Profile Dropdown
            with allure.step("5. Open Profile Dropdown"):
                dropdown_icon = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.profile-img div.dropdown-icon"))
                )
                driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", dropdown_icon)
                time.sleep(1)
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="4_dropdown_opened",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            # Step 6: Confirm Sign Out
            with allure.step("6. Confirm Sign Out"):
                # Wait for dialog with multiple possible selectors
                try:
                    dialog = WebDriverWait(driver, 30).until(
                        EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box"))
                    )
    
                    # Find sign out button with multiple selector attempts
                    sign_out_selectors = [
                        (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.sign-out-btn"),
                        (By.XPATH, "//button[contains(., 'Sign Out')]"),
                        (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button:contains('Sign Out')")
                    ]
    
                    for selector in sign_out_selectors:
                        try:
                            sign_out_btn = WebDriverWait(driver, 5).until(
                                EC.element_to_be_clickable(selector)
                            )
                            sign_out_btn.click()
                            break
                        except:
                            continue
                    else:
                        raise Exception("Sign out button not found")
    
                except Exception as e:
                    allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                                  name="signout_failure",
                                  attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
                    raise e
    
            # Step 7: Verify Logout
            with allure.step("7. Verify Logout"):
                WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.url_contains("auth/login")
                )
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="5_logout_success",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
        except Exception as e:
            allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                          name="test_failure",
                          attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
